name: @miragon/pulse-engine-core
description: The neutral core of the engine family of Pulse: the contract of its dialects (the read port ProcessRuntime, whose reads both dialects answer, the write port ProcessCommands, their ids, read models, queries and failure kinds, and RootCauses, the root-cause rule of every dialect; the writes, bulk operations and migration plans, answered by Camunda 7 alone, and the tenants, whose laws run on Camunda 7 alone, stand ahead of the admission rule, as the README lists), and in ./testing the conformance kit with its laws, its fixed world and an in-memory fake engine. No runtime dependency.
